subject: Reschedule: Console walkthrough + API enablement — two half-day sessions

From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@pathward.com>

Subject: Console walkthrough + API enablement — request to split into two half-days

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo earlier this week. Our engineering and product teams reviewed the scope and we think it would be more effective to split the onboarding into two focused half-day sessions instead of one long day:

- Day 1 (2 hrs): Console walkthrough, RBAC, org/imports, and demo environment access.
- Day 2 (2 hrs): API enablement, keys, example integrations, and hands-on lab.

Can we do these next week? Current preferred windows (PST):
- Tue 6/8, 09:00–12:00 (we can take a 10:30–10:45 break)
- Thu 6/10, 13:00–16:00

If those don't work, happy to be flexible — Sophie and I can shift. I attached our internal onboarding checklist for context.

Also, we have a compliance reviewer who needs to join for 30 minutes on Day 1 (brief SOC2/data residency Q&A). Can you confirm an internal backup if the primary host is pulled into another meeting?

Best,
Alex

Attachments: Pathward_Onboarding_Plan_v1.pdf

We can do both of those days but need to confirm internal availability for the hosts: I can lead Day 1 (console) and Ben can lead Day 2 (API/hands-on). Camila will be the backup for either session.

Proposed confirmed slots (PST):
- Tue 6/8, 09:30–11:30 (I pushed the start 30m to accommodate another customer call)
- Thu 6/10, 13:00–15:00

A couple of asks before Day 1 to make the time productive:
- Please share a service account or test keys that we can use in the hands-on lab (Day 2).
- Share any IP allowlist or network restrictions if the workshop machines need access to private instances.

I'll follow up with calendar invites after internal confirmation.

— Mina
